known_risks.description: Lost local dependencies (numpy, fastembed) when compiling workspace indexes, triggering silent fallback.
known_risks.mitigation: Enforce strict execution using layers/l2_brain/.venv/bin/python, and keep regression gates inside test suites.

known_risks.description: Local models download large binaries, causing high latency or out of memory states.
known_risks.mitigation: Enforce lightweight bge-small-en-v1.5 and deterministically limit max candidate vectors to rerank.
